pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped brownish-tan regions with diffuse pixel gradients at the borders. Patches exhibit a spatial area gradient, with larger, more elongated shapes on the neck transitioning to smaller, more densely packed polygons on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. The network continuity is maintained across the entire visible midsection and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck line, indicating a short, uniform mane against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark circular focal disruption is visible on a patch in the central neck region. A large, prominent anatomical protrusion is present at the ventral base of the neck (brisket area).
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced convex swelling located at the anterior-ventral chest junction, creating a distinctive deviation in the animal's silhouette.
